tier1.text: The extensor hallucis longus helps raise the front of the foot, a movement called dorsiflexion. This muscle sits at the front of the leg, between the knee and the ankle. There, the extensor hallucis longus lies under another muscle, the tibialis anterior.

quotes.quote: The muscles in the anterior compartment of the leg: the tibialis anterior, a long and thick muscle on the lateral surface of the tibia, the extensor hallucis longus, deep under it, and the extensor digitorum longus, lateral to it, all contribute to raising the front of the foot when they contract.
